description: Keeps your documentation in sync with your code — LLM-powered doc updates on every PR
rules: Use `docsync generate` to create initial documentation before running `docsync init`.
The GitHub Action requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY in repository secrets.
Run `docsync check --dry-run` to preview proposed doc updates without posting to GitHub.
The `.autodocs/map.json` index must exist before `docsync check` runs — it is built automatically by `docsync generate` or `docsync init`.
docsync only documents public symbols — functions, classes, interfaces, and type aliases extracted via tree-sitter.
